Consider a BPNN with:  
Input Layer: 2 neurons with inputs [1.0.0.5]  
Hidden Layer: 2 neurons with weights  
$$Wi: = 0.4, Wx = 0.3 (for neuron 1)$$  
$$Wa: = 0.5, w22 = 0.6 (for neuron 2)$$  
Output Layer: 1 neuron with weights from hidden:  
$$Vz 0.7, v2=0.8$$  
Bias: 0.1 for hidden and 0.2 for output  
Activation: Sigmoid function  
Tasks:  
i) Compute the output from each hidden neuron  
ii) Compute the final output from the network  
$$iii) If target = 0.9, calculate the error (use MSE)$$  
B) Analyze the flow of Mamdani and Sugeno fuzzy inference systems with an example  
involving room temperature control. (5)  
4) A fuzzy logic system controls Fan Speed based on  
Temperature and Humidity as input variables. The  
fuzzy sets are defined as:  
A)  
Temperature: {Low, Medium, High}  
Humidity: {Dry, Normal, Wet}  
FanSpeed (Output): {Slow, Moderate, Fast}  
The following rules are used:  
IF Temperature is High AND Humidity is Dry  
THEN FanSpeed is Fast  
IF Temperature is Medium AND Humidity is  
Normal THEN FanSpeed is Moderate  
IF Temperature is Low OR Humidity is Wet (5)  
THEN FanSpeed is Slow  
Given the input values:  
$$Temperature = 78°F - wich = 0.7, UMedium = 0.3,$$  
$$Humidity = 40\% - Upry = 0.6, UNonnal = 0.4, wp Wet$$  
$$=0$$  
Compute the firing strength for each rule using  
AND/OR operators (use min for AND, max for  
OR. Briefly explain how these will contribute to  
the final FanSpeed decision (no need to defuzzify)  
B) Given chromosomes: xj = 43 215678 and x2=8765 43 2. Use fitness = count of  
even numbers. Rank and perform crossover at 5. (5)
